title: Committing Chough evidence makes that evidence stale
symptom: After cases run and committing .chough/, next reports the observation stale-revision-or-inputs; an empty commit does too
trigger: Any commit after recording an observation
expected: Only a change to fingerprinted content stales an observation
actual: snapshot() in src/evidence.rs hashes the HEAD revision into the fingerprint
impact: Committed evidence can never read as current
source: CorvidLabs/chough#10 (Raven run, CorvidLabs/raven#644); reproduced on main 2756dc2

notes.text: Reproduced before the fix by the new tests; see .chough/artifacts/bug-0015-reproduction.log.
status: open -> verified. Fixed in 4bf46da; the reproduction tests pass at e806f78 (.chough/artifacts/bug-0015-fixed-reproduction.log).

The reproduction was a test-log observation recorded with evidence add before the fix, not a case-run observation: the regression case definitions TC-cli-0067, 0068, 0069, 0073 and 0074 arrived with the fix commit 4bf46da, so they could not run at the unfixed tip. This note links their current passing case-run observations at the review-fix head.
